name: clinexa-platform
description: Clinexa Platform — NestJS backend and Next.js internal management application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,admin -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @clinexa/api && npm run typecheck -w @clinexa/admin
